name: Brain Operator
description: Agent DevTools for local AI developers using Claude Code and Codex with markdown vaults. One Operator front door you point to resume or start fresh, bringing your files, continuity, and the right context. Scores each run's retrieval faithfulness and charts it over time in a local Observatory, exports Answer Trace and Agent Receipts, and keeps writes scoped and git-checked. Technical preview.
author: Ege Deniz
